newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products up $1, gas oil slightly tighter.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products up $1, gas oil slightly tighter.

text.p: NWE oil products all gained about $1 a tonne on Friday morning, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges were offered at $191 fob Rotterdam, up $1 from Thursday's close, but bids still clung to $188.
Heating oil barges gained as IPE futures strengthened and as premium edged slightly higher.

Some traders said that the higher offers, around IPE May +$1.25/$1.50 fob ARA came as supply in the second half of April appeared a touch tighter, this the result of large volumes of lifting in the first half.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $83 fob Rotterdam in early business and at $84 fob Antwerp. The market later sagged with $82.50/$83 offered.
"It went up rather too much early on and has fallen back into line now," one trader said.
Bunker demand was slightly over 10,000 tonnes, the bulk of it from one major.
